items.title: CrowdStrike Holdings (CRWD) Lands Frost Radar Honor As New AI Agent Risks Rise
items.summary: CrowdStrike Holdings (NasdaqGS:CRWD) was named a Visionary Leader in the 2026 Frost Radar AI Security Operations Centers report. The report cited CrowdStrike for work on agentic security operations centers and AI driven security tooling. CrowdStrike introduced Agentic Adversary Emulation, an AI system designed to simulate autonomous attacker behavior against customer environments. The firm also launched Agent Insider Threat Detection to monitor and flag risky or abusive actions by AI agents...
